title: ProRAG-FL: Blockchain-Anchored Provenance-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Federated Intrusion Detection for Cloud-IoT Systems
description:
ProRAG-FL is a robust, decoupled three-tier trust architecture for federated intrusion detection in heterogeneous Cloud-IoT networks. It addresses three independent attack surfaces: model trust (via Hyperledger Fabric blockchain-anchored update provenance and Byzantine-resilient aggregation), knowledge trust (via deterministic Merkle tree CTI chunk integrity and a 6-point Hard Provenance Filter), and decision trust (via dual-path calibration/Mahalanobis OOD escalation and evidence-grounded structured LLM reasoning).

This release contains the complete research artifact suite, including dataset adapters for CICIoT2023 and Edge-IIoTset, 12 competitive IDS and FL baseline implementations, 5 adversarial threat models, frozen multi-seed experiment runners (5 seeds: [13, 37, 73, 101, 211]), statistical significance test engines (with Benjamini-Hochberg FDR adjustments), camera-ready LaTeX table and vector figure generators, and an automated 48-check reproducibility audit suite.
